description: You are analyzing an E. coli outbreak using Epi Info 7 Classic Analysis. The EColi FoodHistory dataset is already loaded (359 records). Create a 2x2 contingency table to investigate whether hamburger consumption (HAMBURGER) is associated with illness (ILLDUM) in this outbreak. The output should display a 2x2 table showing counts of exposed and unexposed cases and controls, along with the odds ratio, 95% confidence interval, chi-square statistic, and p-value.
